name: nonzero means
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 随机变量或响应均值不为零的统计状态。

complete_examples.text: Numerical results also show that the transient probability density function solutions of the system responses are not symmetric about their nonzero means due to the existence of even nonlinearities.
It is also found from the numerical analysis that the transient PDF responses of the system are not symmetric about their nonzero means due to the existence of even nonlinearities.
